Hydration = your secret superpower! 💧
So often we think we're hungry when we're really just thirsty. Sip throughout the day (aim for ~64 oz!) to boost energy, digestion, and curb cravings.

And when you are hungry? Snack smart with simple whole-food pairings:
🥕 Veggies + hummus
🍎 Apple + peanut butter
🍓 Fruit + Greek yogurt

Easy, healthy, no prep — my fave kind of snack! 💚
